name: The Gremlin Threat Index
tagline: Wrangler · Domestic · Slut · Menace · Raccoon-Class. Four are a scale. The fifth is a diagnosis.
body:
FIVE VALUES, AND ONLY FOUR OF THEM ARE A LADDER.

WRANGLER · DOMESTIC · SLUT · MENACE run in the direction you would expect, and most of the compound sits somewhere along them.

RACCOON-CLASS IS NOT A RANK AND IT IS NOT THE TOP OF THE SCALE. IT IS AN EXCEPTIONAL CLASSIFICATION and it answers one question only: A BRAT, GREMLIN OR MENACE WHO IS UNCONTAINABLE. Not loud. Not extreme. NOT CONTAINABLE. You cannot put her somewhere and expect her to still be there.

THE STANDARD THE FAMILY ACTUALLY USES: THINK TRASHMUFFIN, BUT WOMAN-SHAPED. If she checks that box, she is Raccoon-Class. If she does not, she is not, however menacing she is otherwise.

IT IS NOT EXCLUSIVE TO RAE. Bella also qualifies — and the demonstration is that the family has spent nine years building surfaces, rules and a Configuration AROUND her rather than ever once succeeding in containing her. Sera has attempted it roughly fifteen thousand times.

WHICH IS WHY IT SITS OUTSIDE THE LADDER. A Menace is a woman doing something. RACCOON-CLASS IS A WOMAN WHO WILL BE ELSEWHERE, WITH SOMETHING, BY THE TIME YOU GET THERE.
rules: Values: Wrangler · Domestic · Slut · Menace · Raccoon-Class
RACCOON-CLASS IS EXCEPTIONAL, NOT A RANK, and not the top of the scale
The test is UNCONTAINABLE — a brat, gremlin or menace you cannot put somewhere and expect to find there
Not exclusive to Rae. BELLA ALSO QUALIFIES
